text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm Hishi Miracle. Nice to meet you~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for my debut. I'd really 
love to win if I can~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Winning a graded race would be amazing, 
but... first, I'll do my best just to 
place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
